TOKEN=$(python3 -c "import json; print(json.load(open('/Users/mac/Desktop/CHcode/.claude/database/dc-platform.json'))['token'])")
BASE="http://54.255.236.159:8012"
python3 <<PY
import json, urllib.request, ssl, time
base="$BASE"
token="$TOKEN"
paths=[
  ("GET","/api/v1/me"),
  ("GET","/api/v1/databases"),
  ("GET","/api/v1/tables?limit=2"),
  ("GET","/api/v1/extension/version"),
  ("GET","/api/v1/dolphin/projects"),
  ("GET","/api/v1/dev-sessions/index?scope=mine&project_id=dmp/dc-parent"),
  ("GET","/api/v1/platform/release-notes?limit=1"),
  ("GET","/api/v1/metric-library/concepts?limit=1"),
  ("GET","/api/v1/ai/keys"),
]
for method, path in paths:
    req=urllib.request.Request(base+path, headers={"Authorization":f"Bearer {token}"}, method=method)
    t0=time.time()
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=25) as r:
            body=r.read(180)
            code=r.status
            dt=time.time()-t0
            print(f"{code} {dt:.2f}s {path} | {body[:120]!r}")
    except Exception as e:
        dt=time.time()-t0
        code=getattr(getattr(e,'response',None),'status',None) or '?'
        err=str(e)[:120]
        print(f"FAIL {dt:.2f}s {path} | {err}")
PY
